description: The ownership gap is the size of the difference between the two, with the sign ignored.

b.request: For each `corpeventprx` value in sentimentandfundamentals, with NULL as its own group, return the group's AVG(anlycount), its AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) with missing inputs excluded, and that AVG gap minus the plain average of all groups' AVG gaps (no rows if that plain average is NULL, no rounding)
b.sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS plain_avg_gap FROM g
)
SELECT g.corpeventprx,
       g.avg_anlycount,
       g.avg_gap,
       g.avg_gap - o.plain_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall
FROM g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.plain_avg_gap IS NOT NULL;

c.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and what is the average gap between insider ownership (`inholdpct`) and institutional ownership (`instownpct`)? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain average of all the event types' average gaps; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything. The ownership gap is the size of the difference between the two, with the sign ignored.
c.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM group_stats) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_diff_from_overall FROM group_stats g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL;

a.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, show the event type, the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and the average absolute difference between insider ownership and institutional ownership (|`inholdpct` − `instownpct`|). Ignore the sign of that difference, so it is never negative. Also show the event type's average difference minus the plain average of all the event types' average differences; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
a.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.event_type, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

d.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots lacking an event type grouped separately, what is the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`), and what is the average absolute gap between insider ownership (`inholdpct`) and institutional ownership (`instownpct`), ignoring missing values? Also report each event type's average absolute gap minus the plain average of all event types' average absolute gaps, which can be negative. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and do not round any values.
d.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM grp) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_gap, g.avg_abs_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL;
